findings.summary: Sample check for R1 relies on AT1, but AT1 does not explicitly test the 'exactly one' constraint (e.g., providing multiple plan_package_final.json inputs) nor the case where plan_package_final.json is provided without its required structured handoff bundle; this leaves a traceability gap for the full requirement semantics.

evidence.note: R1 includes 'accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle)'.
evidence.quote: The Implementation Council subsystem SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle) as its sole canonical planning input...

evidence.note: AT1 tests chat log and unapproved non-canonical artifacts, but not multiple plan inputs or missing handoff bundle.

findings.summary: Sample check metadata maps R2 to milestones [M1, M2], but M2 exit criteria does not include AT2 (the mapped acceptance test) or any other explicit R2 gating; this appears to be a trace-graph/milestone-mapping inconsistency for the provided sample check.

evidence.note: R2 sample check claims coverage in milestones M1 and M2 via AT2.
M2 exit criteria list omits AT2.
AT2 is the acceptance test mapped to R2 in the sample check.
